peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 29.3% below its local comparables; 4 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (94.3): 6.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 368 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,950,000 ($1,809 psf, 1,076–1,162 sq ft; 6 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,561 psf (range $1,528–3,038); 29.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $811,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Katong Park MRT about 340 m, Dakota MRT about 890 m; closer than 484 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 1,210 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 950 m), more than 93 of 662 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Blk 4a Jalan Batu Hawker Centre/Market about 590 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 190 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 490 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 540 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 930 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,090 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,150 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,320 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,330 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,360 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 317 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 444 new sales and 758 resales (1,202 purchases); new sales were 36.9% of these purchases. Subsales (38) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,020 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 758 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 324 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 758 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 889 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.7%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
